name: The Sun
summary: Daylight is safe for some and deadly for others.

sections.heading: Who burns
sections.body:
- [[human|Humans]] and [[witch|Witches]] are safe in daylight.
- [[vampire|Vampires]] catch fire outdoors and take heavy burn damage.
- [[original-vampire|Originals]] are hurt by the sun but cannot be killed by it.
- [[original-hybrid|Original Hybrids]] do not burn.

sections.heading: Holy places
sections.body: Vampires burn inside holy places such as the [[church]], and cannot enter church interiors. Hiding in a church is a myth.

sections.heading: Day and night
sections.body: How long a day or a night lasts is [TBC]. On [[private-servers]], the owner can set the time.
